events.text: The Republic of Turkey is proclaimed.
Black Tuesday: the Wall Street Crash deepens, starting the Great Depression.
Israel invades the Sinai Peninsula, starting the Suez Crisis.
The first message is sent over ARPANET, the forerunner of the internet.
John Glenn, aged 77, returns to space aboard Space Shuttle Discovery.
Hurricane Sandy makes landfall in New Jersey.
